COMPLAINTS

Tell us when something
is wrong.

How to raise a complaint about HeyDock website handling or a service discussion. Contractual dispute processes in a signed agreement take priority for that engagement.

Plan your projectExplore services

HOW TO RAISE A COMPLAINT

What to send.

Contact operations@hdocks.com or the enquiry form. Include:

  • Your name, company and preferred reply email
  • A clear description of the issue and when it happened
  • Any relevant enquiry reference, quote or site location
  • The outcome you are seeking

Do not include passwords or unnecessary sensitive personal data.

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

Acknowledgement and investigation.

We review complaints sent through the published contact channel, acknowledge receipt, and investigate with the people involved in the enquiry or delivery discussion. You should receive a substantive response once the facts are checked.

No fixed public response-time targets are published on this page because HeyDock has not approved numbered complaint SLAs for the website. If a signed client agreement sets complaint or escalation timelines, those contractual terms apply to that client.

ESCALATION

If you remain dissatisfied.

Ask for the complaint to be reviewed by a more senior contact via the same channel. For privacy complaints you may also contact the ICO. For contractual disputes, follow the dispute clause in your agreement.
